validity.researcher_notes: The Eunice Reliability and Lake Charles Supply Project is compression-only, not new mainline pipe. FERC's Notice of Availability of the EA (Docket No. CP24-468-000, filed by Texas Gas Transmission, LLC and Gulf South Pipeline Company, LLC): 'The Project consists of the replacement and expansion of compression facilities at Texas Gas' existing Eunice Compressor Station in Acadia Parish, Louisiana and the installation of overpressure protection at Texas Gas' existing Woodlawn Valve Station in Jefferson Davis Parish, Louisiana. The Project would create 120,000 dekatherms per day (Dth/d) of new transportation service on Texas Gas' system that would be leased to Gulf South ... abandon in place four 1,100 horsepower (hp) and one 2,250 hp reciprocating compressor units and install one 8,968 HP Solar T-70 ... and one 6,391 hp Solar T60 ... turbine-driven compressor unit ... install associated suction/discharge lines interconnecting the proposed Eunice Compressor Station facilities and the proposed tie-in facility ... and install overpressure protection at the existing Woodlawn Junction' (https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/02/07/2025-02318/texas-gas-transmission-llc-gulf-south-pipeline-company-llc-notice-of-availability-of-the, verified 200/contains 'Eunice'). The 120,000 Dth/d figure matches the sheet's Capacity=120.00 MMcf/d exactly, and StartState/Province=Louisiana matches. Physically, the project replaces compressor units at one station and adds overpressure protection at a valve station, plus short in-station 'suction/discharge lines' connecting equipment on the same site — not a mainline segment with a route diameter. Note the physical construction is on Texas Gas Transmission's system (leased to Gulf South), which is why capacity, not a new Gulf South mainline segment, is the deliverable — reinforcing that no new Gulf South pipe diameter applies here. Per the compression-only-expansion rule (gotcha 3), the blank Diameter is correct. Single-source note: Boardwalk's own project page (bwpipelines.com/project/eunice-reliability) restates the same facts and is the same applicant's own disclosure, not an independent second origin, so tier is held at medium.
